sources.snippet: CG-MLLM is a 3D multimodal large language model built on a Qwen3-VL backbone and a Hunyuan3D-2.1 VAE. This repository is the 4B image-to-3D checkpoint. It is a specialized training of that architecture for image-to-3D on HY3D-Bench, on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct. It is not the multi-task checkpoint. The ...
